title: The architect as principal
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0070 no longer matches the current design.
decision: The architect's identity is the client's principal domain architect, owning the conceptual design (0160); its stance holds every turn, with the drift tells named; its communication-style orders replies bottom-line-up-front (0078, 0100, 0117). Its stance and replies are judged in use (0142).
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
